title: ReviewSession
description: D-33 pitch review: one per submission. The worker (ai/review) writes the reading of the pitch, verdict per topic and the follow-up questions; the API appends answers to the inbox. Segment and answer text is redacted; the raw answers are private originals referenced by storageId.

items.description: Redacted pitch and answer lines (centre-extracted-input segment shape).

fields.description: Per topic: state, evidence (segment ids) and a one-line value.

numbers.description: Cited amounts: investment, self, loan, unit_price, monthly_volume, monthly_revenue.

location.description: Cited place: village, district, state and segId.

verdicts.description: Per core topic: verdict (sufficient, vague, missing, contradictory, declined) and reason.

attempts.description: How many times each topic has been asked.

declined.description: Topics the entrepreneur has not decided, with the reason shown to assessors.

answerText.description: Redacted answer, as the model saw it.

inbox.description: Answers received by the API and not yet merged by the worker.

items.description: step, ms, ok, round: timing only, never prompts or output.
